data.one_liner: DXF package for Dart to create, read, update and delete AutoCAD DXF files.
data.what_it_does: Provides Dart classes representing DXF entities and utilities to generate DXF strings or parse existing DXF content. Supports common entities like lines, circles, arcs, polylines, text, etc.
use_when: You need to generate or read DXF files in a pure Dart/Flutter project
You want a lightweight, pure‑Dart solution without native dependencies
avoid_when: You require advanced CAD features or full DXF spec coverage
Performance‑critical rendering of large CAD files is needed
strengths: Pure Dart, works on all Flutter platforms
Supports a range of basic DXF entities
Null‑safe and easy to add to pubspec
weaknesses: Limited entity coverage compared to full CAD libraries
No active mention of recent maintenance
